title: 3rd Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/3/2/2025).

First reading of the resolution submitted by Baarah MP Ibrahim Shujau to gauge the views of 20th Majlis members on the amendments made to Law No. 7/2010 (Decentralisation Act) in the 15 years since it came into force, and on the difficulties and challenges faced in running the decentralised system.

Preliminary debate on the resolution submitted by Baarah MP Ibrahim Shujau to gauge the views of 20th Majlis members on the amendments made to Law No. 7/2010 (Decentralisation Act) in the 15 years since it came into force, and on the difficulties and challenges faced in running the decentralised system.
Independent Institutions Committee report on the President's submission to appoint a member to the Maldives Broadcasting Commission under Article 6(b) of Law No. 16/2010 (Broadcasting Act).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting introduced and began debating a resolution reviewing 15 years of the Decentralisation Act, and took a committee report on a nominee for the Maldives Broadcasting Commission.
